title: Complimenting an Opponent After a Good Hand
summaryJa: ポーカーテーブルで、あなたが相手の上手なプレーを見た後、ハンド終了後に友好的に褒める場面です。テーブルでの良好な人間関係を築き、自然な英会話を練習するのに役立ちます。
segments: You: That was a nice bluff on the river. Well played.
Opponent: Thanks! I thought you might fold there.
You: Yeah, I almost did. Good read.
Opponent: How long have you been playing tournaments?
You: About three years now. It's my first time at this level.
Opponent: Nice. You're playing solid poker. Good luck the rest of the day.
